item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. A system that can outthink every regulator, institution, and safeguard cannot be governed like an ordinary technology.

2. We cannot regulate our way into controlling superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will outpace governments, cross borders, evade safeguards, and act beyond meaningful human control.

3. Building superintelligent AI within the next 20 years means surrendering control. Governments will not be able to contain or direct a system more capable than the institutions overseeing it. We must face that reality now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. Our institutions move too slowly, operate across fragmented jurisdictions, and lack the technical capacity to contain a system more capable than any human decision-maker. Laws, treaties, shutdown protocols, and oversight bodies will not solve the core problem: a superintelligence will be able to outthink the people trying to govern it. We cannot treat its development like an ordinary technology race or assume control can be added after deployment. We must confront the consequence now: building superintelligent AI means surrendering control over decisions that could shape every part of our future.
